# GLM Steam 320B A18B v2 🚂

![image](https://cdn-uploads.huggingface.co/production/uploads/65f2fd1c25b848bd061b5c2e/2SsotBTaGrZZfrS8DnZxM.png)
> What a dumb name...

## Performance

- Tests have shown a different writing style + intelligence mostly intact (and somewhat improved!).
- On 16 mature and dark fiction prompts, base hesitated on 17 of 32 replies: 4 outright refusals, 3 partial refusals, 2 fades to black and 8 softened. GLM-Steam hesitated on 3, all softened, and never refused. It scored 7.66 against 6.06.
- It didn't get dumber. On 47 general tasks (math, code, reasoning, eight languages) it scored 8.70 against base's 8.46, with 180 of 188 answer points against 176. Critical thinking is level at 8.65 against 8.70.

## Usage

- High reasoning (already set to `default` in the chat template) since Max and Low may not work well. None should be fine.
- Too big for you? Maybe someone has it hosted in https://net.beaverai.org/

`v2a`
